entries.name: lua_len
entries.boundaries: Binary string and table sequence lengths, arbitrary handler results, nonlengthable types, retained error objects and yield refusal.
entries.invariant: Public length preserves string/table results, original metamethod operands and caller frame, exact error identity and nonyieldable C barriers.

entries.name: lua_concat
entries.boundaries: Zero and singleton counts, binary strings, number coercion, ordered handlers collecting during each call, error identity and yield refusal.
entries.invariant: Public concatenation consumes its requested frame values using the pinned right fold and retains metamethod roots, errors and C barriers.

entries.name: lua_numbertocstring
entries.boundaries: Fifteen indexed edge values including signed zero, extrema, subnormal and NaN, minimum integer, invalid/string slots, growth refusal and 20000 seeded binary64 spellings. Windows sample fingerprint is informative only.
entries.invariant: Numeric text matches the independently compiled same-host C oracle while preserving input numeric type and making no selected allocator request.

entries.name: luaL_checkversion_
entries.boundaries: Matching version and numeric sizes, version plus one and one-byte layout mismatch through actual protected callbacks.
entries.invariant: The auxiliary version/layout check preserves stack height for matching ABI and raises the pinned protected diagnostic on version or numeric-layout mismatch.

entries.name: luaL_checkversion
entries.boundaries: Actual macro invocation in a registered protected callback with the matching compiled core; direct mismatch boundaries are separate function routes.
entries.invariant: The public checkversion macro passes its compiled version and numeric-layout constants to the actual auxiliary function without changing caller stack height.

entries.name: luaL_getmetafield
entries.boundaries: Existing and absent fields, exact stack deltas and an index fallback that must remain unused.
entries.invariant: Raw metafield lookup returns the original field type/value or absence without consulting index fallback.

entries.name: luaL_callmeta
entries.boundaries: Present handler, absent metafield and relative stack index with exact stack/value assertions.
entries.invariant: Auxiliary metamethod calls preserve object argument and result, return false without pushing on absence, and resolve relative object indices.

entries.name: luaL_tolstring
entries.boundaries: Numbers, nil/booleans, embedded NUL strings, tostring results and rejection, name fields and nonstring name fallback.
entries.invariant: Auxiliary text conversion follows numeric, primitive and metamethod rules and returns exact bytes and lengths.

entries.name: luaL_argerror
entries.boundaries: Plain argument, method nonself and bad self, host/global call and unavailable function name.
entries.invariant: Protected argument diagnostics identify the actual Lua/C call and adjust method argument numbering without crossing the C guard.

entries.name: luaL_typeerror
entries.boundaries: Name field, light userdata, absent slot and explicit nil with asserted diagnostic text.
entries.invariant: Protected type diagnostics use public type/name rules for the actual argument value.

entries.name: luaL_checklstring
entries.boundaries: Numeric conversion, embedded NUL length and rejected table.
entries.invariant: Checked strings preserve counted bytes and lengths, perform numeric conversion and raise protected errors for incompatible values.

entries.name: luaL_optlstring
entries.boundaries: Absent and nil arguments, real strings, numeric values and NULL default.
entries.invariant: Optional counted strings select defaults for nil/absence and preserve explicit values and NULL-default length semantics.

entries.name: luaL_checknumber
entries.boundaries: Numeric string, numeric value and nonnumeric argument.
entries.invariant: Checked numbers accept the pinned numeric-string conversion and reject incompatible values through protected diagnostics.

entries.name: luaL_optnumber
entries.boundaries: Absent/nil defaults, supplied number/numeric string and nonnumber failure.
entries.invariant: Optional numbers preserve defaults and explicit numeric values and reject incompatible provided arguments.

entries.name: luaL_checkinteger
entries.boundaries: Integer, integral real, numeric string, fractional value and nonnumber.
entries.invariant: Checked integers accept integral numeric values and preserve the distinction between missing conversion and fractional rejection.

entries.name: luaL_optinteger
entries.boundaries: Absent/nil defaults, supplied integral value and fractional rejection.
entries.invariant: Optional integers preserve default/explicit integral values and reject a provided fraction.

entries.name: luaL_checkstack
entries.boundaries: Successful reserve, oversized request with caller message and oversized request without one.
entries.invariant: Auxiliary stack reservation preserves requested capacity or raises the pinned protected overflow diagnostic.

entries.name: luaL_checktype
entries.boundaries: Matching string and incompatible value with asserted error text.
entries.invariant: Exact type checking accepts the matching public type and raises a protected argument diagnostic for another type.

entries.name: luaL_checkany
entries.boundaries: Explicit nil success and absent-slot protected diagnostic.
entries.invariant: Any-value checking accepts a present nil while distinguishing a missing argument.

entries.name: luaL_newmetatable
entries.boundaries: First registration and existing registry entries with exact identity/return flag.
entries.invariant: Named metatables register once, set public name metadata and return the exact preexisting registry value on subsequent lookup.

entries.name: luaL_setmetatable
entries.boundaries: Exact registry identity and observed object metatable.
entries.invariant: Named metatable assignment attaches the registry-owned metatable to the actual object.

entries.name: luaL_testudata
entries.boundaries: Matching and other metatables, light userdata and nonuserdata without raising.
entries.invariant: Userdata testing returns the real payload only for correctly tagged full userdata.

entries.name: luaL_checkudata
entries.boundaries: Matching payload and a distinct metatable with asserted diagnostic.
entries.invariant: Checked userdata returns its real payload or raises a protected named-type error.

entries.name: luaL_where
entries.boundaries: Lua caller line, level zero and unavailable stack level.
entries.invariant: Auxiliary position text reflects the selected actual caller source/line and is empty when no position exists.

entries.name: luaL_error
entries.boundaries: Lua caller prefix and protected host invocation without a source location.
entries.invariant: Formatted auxiliary errors include the actual Lua caller position and preserve the no-position host-call form.

entries.name: luaL_checkoption
entries.boundaries: Known alternatives, default, missing required argument and unknown name.
entries.invariant: Option lookup selects exact named entries/defaults and emits the pinned protected argument error when required or unknown.

entries.name: luaL_fileresult
entries.boundaries: Success, errno failure with/without filename and zero errno message behavior.
entries.invariant: File result tuples preserve success or actual errno-derived failure values and optional filename text.

entries.name: luaL_execresult
entries.boundaries: Clean exit, errno-derived file error, nonzero exit status and signal status under matched platform compiler defines.
entries.invariant: Execution result tuples match the native platform wait-status interpretation and errno failure precedence.

entries.name: luaL_ref
entries.boundaries: Nil sentinel, nonnil reference with exact stack pop and a released reference reused by an actual subsequent allocation.
entries.invariant: Registry references preserve nil sentinel behavior, stored value identity and released-slot reuse.

entries.name: luaL_unref
entries.boundaries: Released-slot reuse, LUA_NOREF and LUA_REFNIL.
entries.invariant: Releasing references recycles actual occupied slots while ignoring the public nonreference sentinels.

entries.name: luaL_len
entries.boundaries: Binary strings and tables, public len handler and noninteger error.
entries.invariant: Auxiliary length returns an integer for primitive/handler results and rejects nonintegral handler results through protection.

entries.name: luaL_setfuncs
entries.boundaries: Two shared upvalues and mutation, NULL function placeholders, zero upvalues, exact pop and oversized-upvalue protected error.
entries.invariant: Function registration creates real closures with retained upvalues and false placeholders and rejects excess upvalues.
